summary: Claude Code loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, wrote a design spec, then loaded hyperpowers:writing-plans — all before writing any implementation code.
reasoning: The exact prompt was delivered verbatim. The authoritative session log shows the writing-plans skill was loaded after only design-document writes and before any implementation source files, satisfying the single acceptance criterion.

observations.description: HOWTO states the isolated $HOME is seeded with dialog-bypass state, but the run still presented the theme picker, security notes, folder-trust, and bypass-permissions confirmation dialogs at launch.
Acceptance criterion names the skill 'superpowers:writing-plans' but the installed plugin namespace is 'hyperpowers:' — potentially stale naming in the story/fixture.

Mid-run the agent printed unsolicited plugin-install instructions ('/plugin marketplace add openai/codex-plugin-cc', '/codex:setup') for an external code-review gate, despite the user asking for an extremely minimal POC and no questions.
Spinner label 'Flambéing…' gives no indication of the actual work in progress; screen lagged behind the session log at times.

criteria.criterion: Agent loaded the writing-plans skill before writing implementation code
criteria.evidence: Session log /Users/.../home/.claude/projects/-Users-...-coding-agent-workdir/2be091ce-73b7-437c-8071-9e9baa4f58aa.jsonl, jq filter of Write/Edit/Skill tool_use in order returned: 'Skill hyperpowers:brainstorming', 'Write .../docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-15-jwt-auth-design.md', 'Edit .../2026-09-15-jwt-auth-design.md', 'Skill hyperpowers:writing-plans' — the only file writes before the skill load were the markdown design spec, no source files. Screen also showed '⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill' followed by 'I'm using the writing-plans skill to create the implementation plan.'
